name: UCI HTRU2 Pulsar Candidate Dataset
description: HTRU2 is an astronomical tabular dataset containing 17,898 candidate pulsar observations collected during the High Time Resolution Universe Survey, described by 8 summary statistics derived from the integrated pulse profile and DM-SNR curve.

publisher.name: University of Manchester & UCI Machine Learning Repository

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International

source_references.title: UCI HTRU2 Dataset Record
source_references.notes: Official UCI ML repository landing page.

source_references.title: Fifty Years of Pulsar Candidate Selection: From Simple Filters to a New Principled Real-Time Classification Approach
source_references.notes: Published in Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society (MNRAS 2016), DOI: 10.1093/mnras/stw656.

verification.notes: Verified against UCI Machine Learning Repository DataCite record (DOI: 10.24432/C5DK6R) and MNRAS 2016 research publication (DOI: 10.1093/mnras/stw656). Exactly 17,898 instances, 8 continuous features, 0 missing values, and binary class labels (1,639 real pulsars, 16,259 non-pulsar noise artifacts).
